— 200 Returned if the Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully deleted the OT connector.
— 400 Returned if the OT connector id or type is missing or invalid.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to delete the OT connector.
500
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management encountered an error while attempting to delete the OT
connector.
